title: Perform barrier interventions
frozenQuestion: Are distance excursions and completion from exact necessary-detour starts causally contingent on stuck barriers rather than generic common-stream backtracking?

sourceStarts.selectionRule: Every S07 necessary_detour start in an n=4 or n=5 S04 family with exactly one stuck barrier

metricComposition.n4: 371 inversion starts, of which 350 are also footrule and maximum-rank necessary

sourceStarts.reachabilityMeaning: goal-reachable under the frozen S06 existential finite S05 opportunity-path semantics
sourceStarts.notRequired: reachability from the arbitrary S04 anchor

interventions.remove: change only the focal identity fault from stuck to normal
interventions.move: transfer the stuck fault from the focal identity to each normal identity in turn
interventions.add: retain the focal stuck identity and change each normal identity to stuck in turn
interventions.activate: for cell-view only, temporarily treat the focal stuck identity as normal for the guaranteed matched event-0 opportunity, then restore stuck status before terminal evaluation
interventions.targetEnumeration: all eligible normal identities; no target sampling
interventions.traditionalActivationBoundary: not defined because a traditional controller has no scheduled cell actor; all 20 traditional necessary starts remain in remove/move/add arms and are explicitly counted

pairing.preState: identical occupancy, identity-owned Selection cursors, zero ledger, zero activation count, and zero stream counters
pairing.stream: frozen E01 SHA-256 counter-addressed actor and Bubble-side tokens under one pair-block coupling key
pairing.event0Conditioning: deterministically search the 128-bit seed until the focal identity is the event-0 actor; charge that same opportunity in every arm
pairing.streamRemainder: all event-1+ raw actor and side tokens remain untouched and identical by event index; arm-specific side consumption and legal actions may diverge after intervention
pairing.traditionalStream: not applicable; controller execution is deterministic

execution.eventBudgetConvention: The 2,048-opportunity horizon is a common fixed-horizon completion/cost outcome, not an exclusion. A pre-output pilot found at least one active recurrent arm at this horizon; every such arm must receive a separately labelled 32,768-opportunity sensitivity replay without replacing its primary result.
execution.costs: complete E01 reference ledger plus named unit-sum descriptive projection

analysis.primaryPair: each non-baseline arm minus the same-start same-stream baseline
analysis.exactOptimumSensitivity: join persistent-arm starts to the frozen S07 label under the corresponding retained intervention family; activation has no fixed-family S07 label
analysis.uncertainty: 10,000 deterministic cluster-bootstrap resamples over exact structural starts; descriptive finite-corpus intervals, not superpopulation inference
analysis.outcomeRule: supportive only if isolated barrier changes alter exact necessity and/or matched observed excursion, completion, or cost in the directionally interpretable paired results; null if no material paired changes; constraining if effects are placement-specific, opposed, or coverage-limited

hardStops: any of the 407 source starts is lost
any persistent intervention family is absent from S04/S07
any scenario difference outside the declared fault intervention
any cell-view common-prefix actor or raw-side token mismatch
any event-chain, final-distance, ledger, replay, or trace-completeness failure
any primary event-budget arm missing its declared 32,768-opportunity sensitivity replay

protocolAmendment.timing: after the first all-arm execution attempt stopped at the preregistered event-budget gate and before any result table was written
protocolAmendment.reason: active recurrence or very long waiting is a legitimate intervention outcome under E01 semantics; excluding the arm or silently increasing only its primary horizon would bias completion and cost
protocolAmendment.change: retain 2,048 as the common primary horizon, classify event-budget as fixed-horizon non-completion, and add a 32,768-opportunity sensitivity for every budget arm
protocolAmendment.unchanged: all 407 starts, every persistent target, all cell-view pulses, common streams, metrics, costs, pairing, and isolation gates
